column1: # Misspellings and their corrections, written for gramoten, licensed with the code.
# Read by spelling.py: each wrong form is flagged, and its correction is the first
# suggestion. Only forms the added word lists would otherwise accept, or whose right
# form the suggestions do not put first. Format: wrong <TAB> right.
# Not misspellings: пинцет (м.), пинцета and пинсета (ж.) are all standard, мн. пинцети.
# The dictionary lists the misspelt подтискам family beside потискам; every form of it.
